name: one quantifier before a failing atom
reason: from every start, a+ backtracks through the rest of the run before b fails

name: two quantifiers over one run
reason: from every start, each way to split the run between the two stars is tried

name: two dot-stars around a literal
reason: each start pairs every place the first .* can stop with every place the second can

name: a leading caret starts once
reason: one start, which walks the run once

name: a leading caret under m starts once per line
reason: one start per line, each walking its line: the whole input once

name: a first atom that never matches
reason: no start passes the first atom, so only the scan for starts is paid

name: an alternation of two quadratic branches
reason: the branches' work adds; neither multiplies the other

name: a lookahead at every start
reason: a lookaround is one path out, but its body's work is paid at every start

name: a word-long backreference on prose
reason: a capture is at most a word, so each compare is short

name: a backreference to a starred capture
reason: every split of the run into the capture and its repeat is tried from every start, each compare as long as the capture

name: a small counted maximum
reason: a maximum of ten caps the backtracking at each start

name: case-insensitive: A runs over a
reason: under i the unit's run is the whole input

name: case-sensitive: A has no run
reason: without i the unit matches nothing in the input

name: dotall: dot runs over newlines
reason: under s the dot's run is the whole input

name: no dotall: dot stops at each newline
reason: without s the dot matches no newline

name: a class then a digit over letters
reason: the class runs the whole input and the digit never comes

name: a repeated two-character group
reason: the group repeats along the run of its characters, from every start

name: a word before an at sign, on prose
reason: runs are a word long, so each start backtracks a word

name: commas with spaces, on prose
reason: runs of spaces are one long

name: a nested quantifier on a run it can split
reason: a repeated unit with more than one path on this input is exponential: unbounded, never priced

name: sticky starts once
reason: one start under y

name: a property class under u
reason: a letter class runs over the whole input

name: an inline (?m) starts once per line
reason: the inline flag counts as the flag argument does

name: \A starts once even under m
reason: \A is the start of the string whatever the flags

name: a possessive repeat is one path, still tried from every start
reason: one path out, but each start still walks the rest of the run

name: an atomic group is one path
reason: one path out, but each start still walks the rest of the run

name: a conditional's branches add
reason: both branches are priced and added

name: a {,n} count, which only Python spells
reason: a maximum of ten caps the backtracking at each start

name: a scoped flag group reads its run as the whole input
reason: a group that changes flags is read conservatively: its run is the whole input
